people.name: Holy_Place
people.line: The inner sanctuary of the Tabernacle and Temple

translations.web: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.
translations.bsb: Although the high priest brings the blood of animals into the Holy Place as a sacrifice for sin, the bodies are burned outside the camp.
translations.kjv: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.
translations.asv: For the bodies of those beasts whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned without the camp.
